name: whisper-large-v3-turbo

resources.realTimeFactor: ~4-8x on consumer GPU; ~129x on dedicated A100

notes: Sweet spot for production transcription as of 2026. Distilled from large-v3 (32 decoder layers → 4), ~4-8x faster with WER within 0.4 percentage points on real-world audio. Multilingual transcription supported (99 languages) but NOT translation — for audio→English translation use whisper-large-v3 instead. Fits in ~1.5 GB VRAM at int8, runs well on consumer GPUs.
